newsitem.title: ISRAEL: SOCCER-BRUMER INJURY CAUSES ISRAEL DEFENSIVE WORRIES.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BRUMER INJURY CAUSES ISRAEL DEFENSIVE WORRIES.

text.p: Israel coach Shlomo Scharf will have his work cut out in reorganising an already-suspect defensive line-up when his side take on Luxembourg in a World Cup qualifier next Monday.

Scharf will have to forego the services of dependable sweeper Gadi Brumer, whose recurring ankle injury has forced him out of the squad training for the group five away match Israel must win to have any chance of qualifying for the World Cup finals in France in 1998.
The injury has also put paid to Brumer's hopes of continuing trials with English premier league Manchester United, who are interested in him for next season.
One of the 19 in the training squad will be dropped before the team travel to Luxembourg on Friday.

Scharf has recalled defender Moshe Glam and midfielder Alon Harazi, both of Maccabi Haifa, and will also rely on Maccabi Tel Aviv defender Amir Shelah and midfielders Nir Klinger, the veteran captain, and Tal Banin.
Goalkeepers: Rafi Cohen (Hapoel Haifa), Golan Malul (Maccabi Petah Tikva).
Defenders: Assi Domb (Betar Jerusalem), David Amsalem (Betar Jerusalem), Amir Shelah (Maccabi Tel Aviv), Moshe Glam (Maccabi Haifa), Felix Halfon (Hapoel Tel Aviv).

Midfielders: Ran Ben-Shimon (Hapoel Haifa), Alon Harazi (Maccabi Haifa), Yossi Abuksis (Betar Jerusalem), Eyal Berkovic (Southampton, England), Haim Revivo (Celta Vigo), Itzik Zohar (Betar Jerusalem), Alon Hazan (Maccabi Haifa), Nir Klinger (Maccabi Tel Aviv, captain), Tal Banin (Hapoel Haifa).
Strikers: Eli Ohana (Betar Jerusalem), Ronnie Rosenthal (Tottenham, England), Alon Mizrahi (Bnei Yehuda).
